name: DisequalityDispersion.card_saturation_iff
typeText:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype.{u_1} A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} A] (laws : I → A → A)
  (w : A → A),
  Iff
    (Eq.{1} (Finset.card.{u_1} (DisequalityDispersion.codePairs.{u_1, u_2} laws w))
      (Finset.card.{u_1} DisequalityDispersion.guardPairs.{u_1}))
    (∀ (x y : A), Ne.{u_1 + 1} x y → DisequalityDispersion.Admissible.{u_1, u_2} laws w x y)

source.code:
theorem card_saturation_iff (laws : I → A → A) (w : A → A) :
    (codePairs laws w).card = (guardPairs (A := A)).card ↔
      ∀ x y, x ≠ y → Admissible laws w x y := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (codePairs_subset laws w) h.ge
    intro x y hxy
    have hp : (x, y) ∈ codePairs laws w := by
      rw [he]
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hxy⟩
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
  · intro h
    congr 1
    ext p
    simp only [codePairs, guardPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨fun hp => hp.1, fun hp => h p.1 p.2 hp⟩
